نستثني (form X)
# نَسْتَثْنِي (nastaṯnī) /nas.taθ.niː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَثْنَى (istaṯnā)
# نَسْتَثْنِيَ (nastaṯniya) /nas.taθ.ni.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَثْنَى (istaṯnā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
